IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Appleton, Sells, Flannigan, Roberts, Haigh, Dickerson, and Williams

Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the management of the wildstock geoduck resource.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the role of the department of fish and wildlifein the management of the state wildstock geoduck resource; and amendingRCW 79.135.220.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 79.135.220 and 2005 c 155 s 709 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It is the responsibility of the department ((shall)) todesignate the areas of stateowned aquatic lands that are available forgeoduck harvesting by licensed geoduck harvesters in accordance withthis chapter ((79.90 RCW)). (2)(a) It is the primary responsibility of the department of fishand wildlife to: (i) Identify commercial geoduck tracks; (ii) Conduct all geoduck resource assessments and recovery andmortality rate studies; (iii) Set the total allowable catch limits for the harvest ofwildstock geoducks from stateowned aquatic lands. (b) The department may not substitute information from sources p. 1 HB 3052other than the department of fish and wildlife in determininginformation designated as the responsibility of the department of fishand wildlife by this subsection.
